name: M5.OrderCount.two_block_divisibility_count
statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (W : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ), P.Monic → 0 ∉ W → M5.OrderCount.nOne P W k ^ 2 = M5.OrderCount.twoBlockIndicatorSum P W k
guidance: Unfold twoBlockIndicatorSum with classical decidability. Unfold nOne with monicity, then apply pending accepted M5.AnchoredCount.anchored_single_block_count. Expand square as product of two identical filter cardinalities, cast to integer and distribute finite sums of 0/1 indicators. Handles empty domains and k larger than W.card. Return tactic lines only without leading by. Keep the target unchanged.
